summary: As of 2026-08-31, Market Row totals 23,000 RSF across 8 suites with 7 occupied (87.5% by count; 87.83% by area). The printed rent roll shows $48,600/month base rent, but an executed amendment raises Suite 101 to $7,500/month effective 2026-08-01, bringing effective contractual monthly base to $49,100. T12 results (Sep 2025–Aug 2026) show EGI $723,600, operating expenses $216,000, NOI before reserves $507,600, reserves $9,200, and NCF $498,400. Underwriting per the provided plan yields EGI $768,144, operating expenses $223,925.76 (management at the 4% floor on EGI), NOI before reserves $544,218.24, reserves $4,600, and NCF $539,618.24. Indicative value per lender convention (NOI before reserves at a 6.50% cap) is $8.37MM. Loan sizing at the 6.50% sizing rate and 25-year amortization produces limits: LTV $5.44MM, DSCR $5.33MM, and Debt Yield $6.05MM. The binding maximum is the DSCR at approximately $5.33MM, with sizing annual DS of ~$431.7k (1.25x DSCR), first-year contractual DS at 6.25% of ~$422.2k, and estimated cash-out to the borrower of ~$1.83MM after a 1% origination fee and $48k fixed closing costs. In the combined downside (EGI -5% with management recalculated and sizing rate +100 bps to 7.50%, cap rate unchanged), the DSCR limit binds at approximately $4.54MM; stressed NOI before reserves is ~$507.35k. Insurance renewal is verified at $27,600 annually. The lease renewal option for Suite 101 has not been exercised. Prepayment friction is 1% in years 1–2; no swap is assumed.
